mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it indicates labor market deterioration and impending economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.5%, the market perceives unsustainable monetary policy that triggers equity corrections, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the supply shock regime (defined as industrial production declining more than 2.0% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising input costs and reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when INDPRO declines > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, correlating with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST increases > 1.0% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow at an annual rate exceeding 5.0%, it indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of months when RSAFS growth exceeds 5.0% YoY, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the early labor market recovery regime (defined as PAYEMS rising > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity accelerates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 1.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
